title: Home Sales Consultant - Flooring
description:
Our client, the largest UK retailer of carpets and flooring, are looking for sales-driven and customer-focused individuals to join their expanding team of Home Consultants. Working from your own Mobile Showroom (vehicle provided), you will spend most of your time on the road, working with stores, and visiting customers homes every day.

You will have the opportunity to provide customers with great end-to-end service by helping, advising, and measuring flooring. Using your knowledge of exceptional product ranges and in-house software you will bring customers ideas to life in the comfort of their own home and, while doing so, earn a generous commission!

Outstanding customer service skills will be essential as well as the ability to maximise sales via internet leads by presenting suitable products to the customer in their home.

Full, extensive training provided.

Basic salary of £21,850, with OTE of £40,000 £45,000 including commission, plus a generous range of benefits

title: Internal Sales Executive
company: Infinity Recruitment Consultancy Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are looking for a highly organised Internal Sales Executive with a proactive and self-motivated approach, to join our established client based in St Ives.

This full time permanent Internal Sales Executive role combines sales support, customer account management and business development.

Working Monday to Friday 8.30am 5pm you will be responsible for managing customer enquiries, following up quotations, building relationships and identifying opportunities to generate additional sales.

Key Responsibilities for Internal Sales Executive
- Manage customer enquiries, quotations and sales administration.
- Build and maintain relationships with existing and prospective customers.
- Proactively follow up sales leads and quotations to secure business.
- Identify opportunities to upsell and cross-sell products and services.
- Generate new business and reactivate dormant accounts.
- Maintain accurate customer records and CRM information.
- Prepare quotations and proforma invoices.
- Coordinate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer service.
- Support the achievement of sales targets and wider team objectives.

Skills required for the Internal Sales Executive role
- Strong administration and organisational skills
- Previous experience in sales, sales administration or customer service
- A confident communicator with an excellent telephone manner.
- Self-motivated, proactive and able to use your own initiative.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and CRM systems.

What on offer:-
- Competitive salary up to £30,000 + Commission
- Life Insurance
- Contributory Pension Scheme
- Full product training and ongoing career development.
- 33 days holiday (inclusive of Bank Holidays).
- Private healthcare scheme.
- Supportive, friendly, and collaborative team environment.

If you are interested in discussing the opportunity further please apply.

Interviews are being held as CVs are reviewed.

Infinity Recruitment Consultancy Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent, contract and temporary recruitment. By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Infinity Recruitment Consultancy Limited, your personal data may be added to our database as part of the application process. Our privacy policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.

title: Sales Consultant
description:
Retail Sales Advisor Peterborough

Our client is a highly successful UK wide Retail brand. Well established and highly service focused they are now looking to recruit an ambitious, target driven, service lead, Retail Sales Advisor for their Peterborough Store.

The Role:
- You will be engaging with customers on a face-to-face basis and using your consultative selling skills to develop solutions that excite your customers.
- You will be target focused and keen to exceed targets across a range of KPIs
- A strong sales process with the ability to engage with customers, close sales and overcome objections, whilst delivering exceptional service.
- Delivering outstanding after sales service and attracting referrals/repeat business
- Ensuring the highest levels of standards in the store and supporting with promotional changes.
- Highly organised with an eye for compliance.

The Person:
- Candidates MUST have at least 12 months experience in an environment where selling products to customers in a face to face, one on one environment is what you do.
- Where this experience was gained is open. Ideal candidates however will come from assisted sales retail sectors, however if you feel you meet the above criteria, you are invited to apply.
- Driven and ambitious with an engaging personality, target focused and resilient.
- Passionate about delivering exceptional service in a competitive environment.
- Flexible and open to support the business during peak trading patterns.

The Package:

26.3k Basic with Uncapped OTE. Realistic OTE of 49k+

By applying for this role, you are consenting for Gravity Recruit Limited to hold and process your data in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulations. Your details will be added to our candidate database and we may process certain information about you for our legitimate business interests in order to provide you with Recruitment Services. Full details can be found in our Data Protection & Privacy Policy at our website.

If you wish to exercise your right to access, erase or restrict the holding or processing of your data please contact us through our website and we will respond to your query within 48 hours.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive

St Ives, Cambridgeshire Full-time, Office-based £35,000 £40,000

We re working with an established and growing technology-focused business in St Ives, Cambridgeshire, who are looking for a Sales Executive to join their friendly and collaborative team.

This is a varied role suited to someone with previous sales or sales support experience who enjoys working with customers, managing the detail behind the sales process and supporting a wider commercial team.

The Role

You will be responsible for:
- Managing customer enquiries, records and correspondence through the CRM system
- Preparing quotations and processing sales orders accurately
- Selling a range of third-party products and liaising with customers and suppliers
- Supporting the sales team with lead follow-up, reporting and general administration
- Coordinating sales meetings, customer visits and trade events
- Assisting with travel arrangements and wider team projects
- Providing occasional support with marketing activities and exhibitions

About You

We re looking for someone who is organised, proactive and commercially minded, with excellent attention to detail and strong communication skills.

You ll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a sales or sales support role
- Strong organisational and time-management skills
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and CRM systems
- The ability to manage multiple priorities
- A positive, team-focused approach

Experience within a technical, engineering or manufacturing environment would be advantageous.

What s on Offer?
- £35,000 £40,000 salary, depending on experience
- Monthly company-wide bonus scheme after 12 months
- Pension scheme
- Full-time, permanent, office-based position
- Friendly and supportive working environment
- Opportunities for professional development

Interested? Please send your CV to Kerry Chaloupka at (url removed) or call (phone number removed) for more information.

title: Sales Executive - New Business Solutions
description:
KONE is looking for an ambitious, commercially driven Sales Executive to join our New Building Solutions team. This is an exciting opportunity to drive sales growth across a thriving construction market, building relationships with developers, contractors and consultants while delivering major new-build projects.

We're seeking a proven B2 B sales professional with experience in business development, account management and complex solution sales. You may come from the lift industry, construction, building products, engineering, mechanical or electrical services, or another technical sales environment.

Working for one of the world's leading elevator and escalator companies, you'll be responsible for developing opportunities from initial engagement through to contract award, helping customers overcome challenges and achieve their long-term goals.

Territory - Peterborough, Cambridge, Milton Keynes, Luton and the wider East Anglia region.

OTE £75,000-£80,000

Key Responsibilities
- Build and develop relationships with customers, consultants, contractors and developers across your territory.
- Generate new business while growing existing accounts to strengthen KONE's market position.
- Identify, manage and convert opportunities to achieve order intake, revenue and profitability targets.
- Manage the full sales cycle, including tender submissions, negotiations, contract award and handover.
- Promote and upsell KONE's digital and smart building solutions.
- Deliver outstanding customer service and support long-term customer relationships.
- Maintain accurate pipeline, customer and opportunity data within Salesforce.
- Provide timely forecasting, reporting and sales activity updates.
- Conduct regular customer meetings across the territory (typically 2-3 days per week).
- Collaborate with colleagues across KONE to maximise cross-selling opportunities.

Skills & Experience

Essential
- Proven B2 B sales and account management experience, including new business development and customer retention.
- Strong track record of managing complex sales opportunities and delivering against targets.
- Excellent negotiation, commercial and relationship-building skills.
- Experience managing tenders, proposals and customer contracts.
- Good understanding of contractual and financial terms.
- Experience using CRM systems, ideally Salesforce.

Desirable
- Lift/elevator industry experience.
- Construction, building products or built-environment sales experience.
- Technical, engineering or specification sales background.

What KONE can offer:

We offer a competitive salary, 25 days + Bank Holidays +1 paid Volunteering Day, Company Pension Scheme, Private Medical Insurance, Quarterly Commission, EV Car, PDI, Dental Insurance, Gymflex Membership, Life/Partner Assurance & Critical Illness Issurance, Kone Discounts, Cycle to Work Scheme, Long Service Awards, 24/7 GP Support & Wellbeing Access, Employee Assistance Programme, Hybrid Working and Career Development Opportunities to support and help you achieve your goals.

title: Outside Account Manager
description:
Outside Account Manager - Peterborough - up to £40,000 + Company car

Our Client is a dynamic and progressive metals and plastic distributor. They are looking for an Outside Account Manager to join their team in Peterborough.

Key responsibilities of the Account Manager:
- Reviews market analysis and determines customer needs, potential volume, pricing schedule.
- Develops accounts sales campaigns.
- Proactively contacts customers and maintains relationships with those who have existing and business development opportunities and/or have had a history of purchasing from our sister company.
- Travel to customer sites to meet with appropriate stakeholders.
- Increase sales and average order size by means of cross-selling, up-selling and value add services such as fabrication, processing, polishing etc.
- Manage customer needs and ensure a high level of customer service.
- Negotiate terms appropriately to close deal.
- Obtains and relates customer, service and inventory data to appropriate Manager.
- Prepares appropriate reports in agreed format and to agreed timescales.
- Work with the Vice President - Europe (Specialty Distribution or Aerospace) and Business Development Manager to help organise global exhibitions.
- Manage and maintain in-house CRM system keeping compressive records of activities.
- Clearly communicate progress against agreed targets - in format agreed.
- Forecast and track key account metrics.
- Assist with challenging customer requests.
- Liaise with internal sales team to ensure customers' needs are managed appropriately

Key skills of the Account Manager:
- At least 2 years proven account management experience ideally in commercial / aerospace sectors / metals industry
- Tenacious and highly motivated and able to work individually or in a team
- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively both written and verbal
- Ability to influence key stakeholders at all levels of an organisation
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint

Company benefits available for the Account Manager:

Salary - up to £40,000 plus company car

Peterborough office - office based when not out visiting customers.

23 days annual leave (plus Bank Holidays) rising to 28 with service

Pension - 5% employee contribution, 3% employer (rises with service - max 8%)

Life assurance after 3 months service

Income protection after 3 months service

Employee Assistance Programme

24hr GP service

Discount portal

Free car parking
